agent_test_copy_check.name: agent_test_copy_check
agent_test_copy_check.value: not "agent"."test_copy" or ("agent"."kind" = 'client' and "agent"."template_id" is not null)

billing_statement_counts_check.name: billing_statement_counts_check
billing_statement_counts_check.value: "billing_statement"."credits_used" >= 0 and "billing_statement"."credits_included" >= 0 and "billing_statement"."extra_credits" >= 0 and "billing_statement"."credit_price" >= 0 and "billing_statement"."days_in_month" between 28 and 31

build_target_check.name: build_target_check
build_target_check.value: ("build"."kind" = 'agent' and "build"."skill_id" is null) or ("build"."kind" = 'skill' and "build"."agent_id" is null and "build"."test_agent_id" is null)

builder_session_target_check.name: builder_session_target_check
builder_session_target_check.value: ("builder_session"."kind" = 'agent' and "builder_session"."skill_id" is null) or ("builder_session"."kind" = 'skill' and "builder_session"."agent_id" is null)

client_file_website_check.name: client_file_website_check
client_file_website_check.value: "client_file"."website" is null or char_length("client_file"."website") between 1 and 300

connection_mezonas_may_check.name: connection_mezonas_may_check
connection_mezonas_may_check.value:
"connection"."mezonas_may" is null or (jsonb_typeof("connection"."mezonas_may") = 'object'
        and "connection"."mezonas_may"->>'choice' in ('needs', 'any')
        and "connection"."mezonas_may" ? 'until' and "connection"."mezonas_may" ? 'setBy' and "connection"."mezonas_may" ? 'setAt')

connection_change_request_closed_check.name: connection_change_request_closed_check
connection_change_request_closed_check.value:
("connection_change_request"."status" = 'open') = ("connection_change_request"."closed_at" is null)
        and ("connection_change_request"."status" not in ('approved', 'declined', 'withdrawn') or "connection_change_request"."closed_by" is not null)
        and ("connection_change_request"."answer_note" is null or "connection_change_request"."status" in ('approved', 'declined'))

contact_reachable_check.name: contact_reachable_check
contact_reachable_check.value: "contact"."phone" is not null or "contact"."whatsapp" is not null or "contact"."email" is not null

conversation_shape_check.name: conversation_shape_check
conversation_shape_check.value: ("conversation"."kind" = 'direct' and "conversation"."contact_id" is not null and "conversation"."external_id" is null) or ("conversation"."kind" = 'group' and "conversation"."external_id" is not null)

conversation_external_id_check.name: conversation_external_id_check
conversation_external_id_check.value: "conversation"."external_id" is null or length("conversation"."external_id") between 1 and 200

conversation_capture_check.name: conversation_capture_check
conversation_capture_check.value: jsonb_typeof("conversation"."capture") = 'object' and coalesce(jsonb_typeof("conversation"."capture"->'archive') = 'boolean', false) and coalesce("conversation"."capture"->>'attachments' in ('off', 'documents', 'all'), false) and case when jsonb_typeof("conversation"."capture"->'maxBytes') = 'number' then ("conversation"."capture"->>'maxBytes')::numeric between 1 and 33554432 else false end

deal_company_check.name: deal_company_check
deal_company_check.value: "deal"."company" is null or char_length("deal"."company") between 1 and 200

deal_who_check.name: deal_who_check
deal_who_check.value: "deal"."client_id" is not null or "deal"."company" is not null

form_request_submitted_check.name: form_request_submitted_check
form_request_submitted_check.value: ("form_request"."status" = 'submitted') = ("form_request"."answers" is not null and "form_request"."submitted_at" is not null)

inbox_item_undelivered_idx.name: inbox_item_undelivered_idx
inbox_item_undelivered_idx.where: "inbox_item"."status" = 'resolved' and "inbox_item"."run_id" is not null and "inbox_item"."run_received_at" is null

intake_person_language_check.name: intake_person_language_check
intake_person_language_check.value: "intake_person"."language" is null or char_length("intake_person"."language") between 2 and 10

knowledge_chunk_source_ids_check.name: knowledge_chunk_source_ids_check
knowledge_chunk_source_ids_check.value: ("knowledge_chunk"."source_type" = 'entry' and "knowledge_chunk"."entry_id" is not null and "knowledge_chunk"."entry_version_id" is not null and "knowledge_chunk"."document_id" is null) or ("knowledge_chunk"."source_type" = 'document' and "knowledge_chunk"."document_id" is not null and "knowledge_chunk"."entry_id" is null)

ledger_account_note_author_check.name: ledger_account_note_author_check
ledger_account_note_author_check.value: ("ledger_account_note"."source" = 'agent' and "ledger_account_note"."agent_version_id" is not null and jsonb_array_length("ledger_account_note"."sources") > 0) or ("ledger_account_note"."source" <> 'agent' and "ledger_account_note"."user_id" is not null)

message_translation_step_check.name: message_translation_step_check
message_translation_step_check.value: "message_translation"."step_run_id" is null or ("message_translation"."run_id" is not null and "message_translation"."agent_version_id" is not null)

metered_usage_scope_check.name: metered_usage_scope_check
metered_usage_scope_check.value: "metered_usage"."tenant_id" is not null or ("metered_usage"."agent_id" is null and "metered_usage"."run_id" is null)

metered_usage_model_check.name: metered_usage_model_check
metered_usage_model_check.value: ("metered_usage"."measure" = 'model') = ("metered_usage"."cost_usd" is not null) and "metered_usage"."tokens_in" >= 0 and "metered_usage"."tokens_out" >= 0 and "metered_usage"."cache_read_tokens" >= 0 and "metered_usage"."cache_write_tokens" >= 0 and coalesce("metered_usage"."cost_usd", 0) >= 0

oversight_decision_input_check.name: oversight_decision_input_check
oversight_decision_input_check.value: ("oversight_decision"."action" = 'retry_with') = ("oversight_decision"."input_after" is not null) and ("oversight_decision"."input_before" is null or "oversight_decision"."action" = 'retry_with')

owner_check_reviewed_check.name: owner_check_reviewed_check
owner_check_reviewed_check.value: ("owner_check"."result" = 'reviewed') = ("owner_check"."verdict" is not null and "owner_check"."cause" is not null)

person_device_revoked_check.name: person_device_revoked_check
person_device_revoked_check.value: "person_device"."revoked_at" is null or ("person_device"."push_token" is null and "person_device"."public_key" is null)

run_resume_check.name: run_resume_check
run_resume_check.value: "run"."resume_from" is null or "run"."retry_of" is not null

run_audit_mark_note_check.name: run_audit_mark_note_check
run_audit_mark_note_check.value: ("run_audit_mark"."note" is null or length("run_audit_mark"."note") between 1 and 2000) and ("run_audit_mark"."verdict" <> 'problem' or "run_audit_mark"."note" is not null)

run_subject_external_check.name: run_subject_external_check
run_subject_external_check.value: "run_subject"."external_id" is null or "run_subject"."connector" is not null

sign_in_approval_decided_check.name: sign_in_approval_decided_check
sign_in_approval_decided_check.value:
("sign_in_approval"."status" = 'pending') = ("sign_in_approval"."decided_at" is null)
        and ("sign_in_approval"."status" <> 'approved' or "sign_in_approval"."device_id" is not null)

user_factor_shape_check.name: user_factor_shape_check
user_factor_shape_check.value:
("user_factor"."kind" = 'totp' and "user_factor"."twilio_factor_sid" is not null and "user_factor"."phone" is null)
        or ("user_factor"."kind" in ('sms', 'whatsapp') and "user_factor"."phone" is not null and "user_factor"."twilio_factor_sid" is null)

catalog_item_key_signature_key.name: catalog_item_key_signature_key
catalog_item_key_signature_key.where: "catalog_item"."key_signature" is not null and "catalog_item"."merged_into_id" is null

item_alias_key_check.name: item_alias_key_check
item_alias_key_check.value: "item_alias"."vendor_sku" is not null or "item_alias"."description_hash" is not null

quote_line_std_check.name: quote_line_std_check
quote_line_std_check.value: "quote_line"."unit_price_std" is null or "quote_line"."standard_uom" is not null

vendor_contract_terms_check.name: vendor_contract_terms_check
vendor_contract_terms_check.value: ("vendor_contract"."net_days" is null or "vendor_contract"."net_days" between 0 and 365) and ("vendor_contract"."early_pay_discount_pct" is null) = ("vendor_contract"."early_pay_days" is null) and ("vendor_contract"."early_pay_discount_pct" is null or ("vendor_contract"."early_pay_discount_pct" > 0 and "vendor_contract"."early_pay_discount_pct" < 100)) and ("vendor_contract"."early_pay_days" is null or "vendor_contract"."early_pay_days" between 0 and 365) and ("vendor_contract"."min_order_amount" is null or "vendor_contract"."min_order_amount" >= 0)

vendor_item_contract_check.name: vendor_item_contract_check
vendor_item_contract_check.value: "vendor_item"."contract_id" is null or "vendor_item"."list_price" is not null

vendor_item_price_tolerance_check.name: vendor_item_price_tolerance_check
vendor_item_price_tolerance_check.value: ("vendor_item"."price_tolerance_amount" is null or "vendor_item"."price_tolerance_amount" >= 0) and ("vendor_item"."price_tolerance_pct" is null or ("vendor_item"."price_tolerance_pct" >= 0 and "vendor_item"."price_tolerance_pct" < 100))

vendor_item_last_price_check.name: vendor_item_last_price_check
vendor_item_last_price_check.value: ("vendor_item"."last_price" is null) = ("vendor_item"."last_price_on" is null) and ("vendor_item"."last_price" is null or "vendor_item"."last_price" >= 0) and ("vendor_item"."last_price_std" is null or ("vendor_item"."last_price_std" >= 0 and "vendor_item"."last_price" is not null))

vendor_item_list_price_check.name: vendor_item_list_price_check
vendor_item_list_price_check.value: ("vendor_item"."list_price" is null) = ("vendor_item"."list_price_on" is null) and ("vendor_item"."list_price" is null or "vendor_item"."list_price" >= 0)

vendor_item_quantities_check.name: vendor_item_quantities_check
vendor_item_quantities_check.value: ("vendor_item"."std_per_vendor_uom" is null or "vendor_item"."std_per_vendor_uom" > 0) and ("vendor_item"."min_order_qty" is null or "vendor_item"."min_order_qty" > 0) and ("vendor_item"."lead_time_days" is null or "vendor_item"."lead_time_days" >= 0)

vendor_item_sku_check.name: vendor_item_sku_check
vendor_item_sku_check.value: "vendor_item"."sku" is null or length("vendor_item"."sku") between 1 and 100

content_version_sizes.name: content_version_sizes
content_version_sizes.value:
length("content_version"."title") <= 200 and length("content_version"."description") <= 500
        and length("content_version"."body_md") <= 200000 and cardinality("content_version"."target_queries") <= 20

forum_reply_decided.name: forum_reply_decided
forum_reply_decided.value:
("forum_reply"."status" = 'waiting') = ("forum_reply"."decided_at" is null)
        and ("forum_reply"."decided_at" is null) = ("forum_reply"."decided_by_user_id" is null)

marketing_report_action_decided.name: marketing_report_action_decided
marketing_report_action_decided.value:
("marketing_report_action"."decision" = 'open') = ("marketing_report_action"."decided_at" is null)
        and ("marketing_report_action"."decided_at" is null) = ("marketing_report_action"."decided_by_user_id" is null)

site_event_ranges.name: site_event_ranges
site_event_ranges.value:
("site_event"."engaged_ms" is null or "site_event"."engaged_ms" between 0 and 3600000)
        and ("site_event"."scroll" is null or "site_event"."scroll" between 0 and 4)
        and ("site_event"."position" is null or "site_event"."position" between 0 and 100)

site_event_kind_fields.name: site_event_kind_fields
site_event_kind_fields.value:
case "site_event"."kind"
        when 'view' then "site_event"."source_group" is not null and "site_event"."device" is not null
        when 'engage' then "site_event"."engaged_ms" is not null and "site_event"."scroll" is not null
        when 'click' then "site_event"."target" is not null and "site_event"."position" is not null
        when 'form_seen' then "site_event"."form" is not null
        else false end

booking_decider_check.name: booking_decider_check
booking_decider_check.value: "booking"."decided_by" = 'person' and "booking"."user_id" is not null or "booking"."decided_by" <> 'person' and "booking"."agent_version_id" is not null

reconciliation_signed_off_check.name: reconciliation_signed_off_check
reconciliation_signed_off_check.value: ("reconciliation"."status" = 'signed_off') = ("reconciliation"."signed_off_by" is not null and "reconciliation"."signed_off_at" is not null)

crm_match_record_check.name: crm_match_record_check
crm_match_record_check.value:
("crm_match"."decision" = 'matched') = ("crm_match"."record_key_id" is not null)
        and num_nonnulls("crm_match"."record_key_id", "crm_match"."connection_id", "crm_match"."module", "crm_match"."external_id") in (0, 4)

crm_match_step_check.name: crm_match_step_check
crm_match_step_check.value: "crm_match"."step" is null or length("crm_match"."step") between 1 and 200

crm_record_key_embedding_check.name: crm_record_key_embedding_check
crm_record_key_embedding_check.value:
("crm_record_key"."embedding" is null) = ("crm_record_key"."embedded_hash" is null)
        and ("crm_record_key"."embedded_hash" is null or "crm_record_key"."embedded_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
        and ("crm_record_key"."embedding" is null or "crm_record_key"."embedding_model" is not null)
